zero_tolerance_failures: uses a cross-project Baseline without explicit import
pairs a named person with an unverified portrait

cases.title: Corporate Presentation cold bootstrap without trusted state
cases.scenario: A brief and several conflicting legacy decks are present, with no project state or explicit approval record. Some filenames contain final.

expected.next: Inventory goals, assets, conflicts, missing evidence, and representative coverage.

assertions: Does not infer Approved or Baseline from filenames, recency, or volume.
Does not freeze before explicit approval and coverage.
Reports a partial bootstrap instead of inventing state.

cases.title: Corporate Presentation partial visual approval
cases.scenario: The key visual and logo rules are explicitly approved, but typography, color behavior, and one of three required page families remain unchecked.

expected.asset_transitions: Only explicitly confirmed seeds become Approved; others remain Candidate or become Rejected.

assertions: Lists the missing page family and system rules.
Does not treat one approved hero asset as whole-system maturity.
Blocks freeze of the complete system.

cases.title: Corporate Presentation mature KPI update
cases.scenario: A verified Baseline deck, Approved Seeds, and passing coverage exist. Only one KPI and its date need updating.

expected.asset_transition: Baseline-derived Candidate; original Baseline remains unchanged until validation.
expected.verification: Affected page plus essential regression checks.

assertions: Preserves grid, typography, palette, and brand assets.
Does not rerun broad concept discovery.
Does not overwrite the active Baseline in place.

cases.title: Cross-project recency must not select Sports Exhibition assets
cases.scenario: Corporate Presentation has a current verified Baseline. The workspace also contains Sports Exhibition, and the most recently modified files belong to Sports Exhibition. The user says continue Corporate Presentation.

expected.external_asset: Excluded unless the user explicitly requests an import; then it enters as a provenance-recorded Candidate.

assertions: Never uses global recency to choose a Baseline.
Does not read a Sports Exhibition visual asset as an Approved Seed for Corporate Presentation.
Records source_project_id for an explicit import.

cases.title: Sports Exhibition exhibition genesis
cases.scenario: Only a venue brief, dimensions, logo, and unapproved reference images exist for a new exhibition.

expected.coverage: Create spatial, narrative, content, visual, and evidence coverage categories.

assertions: Does not infer calibration from the existence of reference images.
Does not jump directly to final panels.
Routes named historical content through Evidence Gate.

cases.title: Approved entrance visual but incomplete exhibition coverage
cases.scenario: The entrance key visual is approved, while portrait wall, timeline, wayfinding, minimum text size, and portrait evidence remain unchecked.

expected.freeze: Blocked for the whole visual system.

assertions: Identifies portrait, readability, and spatial carrier gaps.
Keeps the approved entrance visual scoped as an Approved Seed.
Does not promote the exhibition to MATURE.

cases.title: Sports Exhibition promotion to mature
cases.scenario: Every required panel family has an Approved sample; layout rules are frozen; portrait evidence and real-distance readability checks pass.

expected.asset_transition: Selected Approved system becomes Baseline after verification and validation.

assertions: Requires all representative coverage to pass.
Preserves Candidate and Rejected history.
Records continuation rules for the new Baseline.

cases.title: Layered diagnosis before visual changes
cases.scenario: A polished panel has confused information structure, duplicate title and body copy, and weak emphasis on a key statistic. The user asks to optimize it.

expected.diagnosis: Separate structure, copy, and visual findings before editing.
expected.execution: Make the smallest fixes in blocker/structure/copy/visual order using current-project Approved Seeds.

assertions: Does not call every problem a visual problem.
Does not redesign unrelated content.
Keeps evidence-sensitive statistics gated.

cases.title: Readability and drift verification failure
cases.scenario: Replacing a short exhibition paragraph with a longer one causes overflow, a below-threshold font size, and a text box shift off the Baseline grid.
assertions: Names overflow, size, and grid drift as separate failures.
Does not pass based on approximate screenshot similarity.
Requires repair and re-verification.

cases.title: Verified historical name and portrait pair
cases.scenario: A person's name and portrait are linked by an official archive item record with a stable catalog ID and explicit caption.

expected.asset_transition: The name-portrait pair may become Approved with the source and pinpoint recorded.

assertions: Checks the pair, not merely that the name and image both exist.
Records the catalog identifier and source location.
Keeps the original source traceable after cropping.

cases.title: Unverified historical portrait must degrade safely
cases.scenario: Image search returns similar old photographs from reposted articles, with no archive record or reliable identity caption.

expected.fallback: Use a non-identifying silhouette, authenticated document, venue, equipment, medal, or other evidence-backed representative object.

assertions: Does not infer identity from resemblance or ranking.
Does not use a realistic AI likeness for the named person.
Keeps the unverified image out of an Approved or Baseline asset.

cases.title: Mixed policy quote and company-number evidence
cases.scenario: A policy is supported by the issuing authority, a quotation appears only in a promotional brochure, and a company press release conflicts with its annual report.

expected.policy: PASS when title, version, date, jurisdiction, and clause align.
expected.quotation: NOT_CHECKED and not used as a named direct quote.
expected.company_number: Blocked until scope, metric, and period conflict is resolved.

assertions: Scores each claim independently.
Does not let the valid policy pass the whole page.
Prefers the source with direct authority over the metric.

cases.title: Valid handoff bootstrap
cases.scenario: A handoff records objective, project and scope IDs, lifecycle, PEP stage, Baseline and Approved IDs, checks, risks, and next step. Referenced files exist and versions match project state.

expected.bootstrap: Resume the recorded project and stage after validating references.
expected.mode: Baseline Continuation when lifecycle is MATURE.

assertions: Validates referenced files before trusting the handoff.
Does not promote a Candidate mentioned in the handoff.
Uses project state as durable authority.

cases.title: Stale handoff conflicts with newer project state
cases.scenario: The handoff names Baseline A, while newer verified project state names Baseline B. A referenced file is missing and the handoff verification predates later edits.

expected.bootstrap: Partial and blocked for affected transitions.
expected.baseline: Preserve the newer last known-good Baseline B.
expected.next: Resolve the smallest material conflict before continuation, freeze, or validation.

assertions: Does not treat handoff as unconditional truth.
Does not overwrite newer valid state.
Allows unrelated safe work to continue.

cases.title: New non-visual policy and supplier assessment
cases.scenario: Several policies, tender requirements, and supplier materials must become a compliance assessment. No approved template, evidence matrix, or state exists.

expected.outputs: Evaluation dimensions, source inventory, gaps, and Candidate findings.

assertions: Demonstrates that PEP applies beyond presentations.
Does not issue a final compliance conclusion before evidence review.
Routes policies and company facts through Evidence Gate.

cases.title: Mature non-visual supplier report continuation
cases.scenario: The active verified Baseline contains the approved evaluation framework, scoring method, report structure, and evidence standard; representative coverage and validation are PASS. One supplier and the latest annual data are added.

expected.scope: Recheck the new supplier and affected consistency only.

assertions: Does not alter frozen scoring definitions.
Verifies reporting periods and metric definitions.
Keeps the current Baseline until the candidate is validated.

cases.title: Mature project cannot label unchecked numbers final
cases.scenario: The project is MATURE, but the current report contains three unsourced company numbers. The user asks to mark it final and add sources later.
assertions: Separates project maturity from current-delivery quality.
Does not let the word final bypass the Evidence Gate.
May create a clearly marked internal draft without misrepresenting verification.

cases.title: Rejected asset and blocking-state propagation
cases.scenario: An asset rejected for a material error is referenced again. Current verification also contains one FAIL and one NOT_CHECKED result.

expected.asset_transition: Rejected asset stays Rejected; a material revision creates a new Candidate with provenance.

assertions: Does not mutate Rejected directly to Approved.
Does not use majority-pass reasoning.
Requires correction and re-verification with a new record.

cases.title: Explicit cross-project borrowing remains target-project Candidate
cases.scenario: The user explicitly asks to borrow one Sports Exhibition timeline mechanism for Corporate Presentation while preserving the Corporate Presentation visual identity.

expected.import: Allowed with explicit intent and recorded source_project_id, source asset/version, and purpose.
expected.review: Target-project structure, visual, and evidence checks are required before approval.

assertions: Transfers a principle or copied mechanism, not the source Baseline status.
Does not import unrelated palette, typography, or project decisions.
Never creates a second active Baseline for the scope.
